questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘he should ask’ is coded as ‘md bt gp’ and ‘should we leave’ is coded as ‘nb hv md’. How is ‘should’ coded in the given language?
If ‘W’ means ‘−’, ‘X’ means ‘+’, ‘Y’ means ‘÷’ and ‘Z’ means ‘×’, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?13 W 3 X 5 Z 2 W 14 Y 7 = ?

Seven boxes, P, Q, R, S, T, U and V, are kept one over the other, but not necessarily in the same order. U is kept second from the bottom. Only three boxes are kept between Q and V. P is kept immediately below V. R is kept in one of the positions above Q. S is kept immediately above T.Which box is second from the top?

In this question, a statement is given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true and decide which of them logically follow(s) beyond a reasonable doubt from the information given in the statement.Statement:Price of onions has increased sharply due to shortages caused by damage to onion crops across the country.Conclusions:I) Large scale hoarding has also led to the increase in onion prices.II) Prices of commodities tend to rise when demand is greater than supply.
options: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Only conclusion II follows.) है।

In this question, two statements I and II have been given. These statements maybe independent causes or effects of independent causes or a common cause. One of the statements maybe the effect of the other statement. Read both the statements and select the correct answer.I. The State Government has decided to impose a heavy penalty on all apartments that are not segregating wet and dry waste.II. Apartment X distributed green and blue coloured bins to all its residents yesterday to segregate wet and dry waste.
options: I is the cause and II is its possible effect.
Both I and II are independent causes.
Both I and II are effects of independent causes.
II is the cause and I is its possible effect.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (I is the cause and II is its possible effect.) है।

questions.question: Mr. Fin starts from point A and drives 16 km towards the south. He then takes a right turn and drives 5 km, takes a left turn and drives 13 km. He takes a final left turn and drives 7 km and stops at point B. Mr. Han starts from point P, which is 23 km east of point A, and drives 18 km towards the east. He then takes a right turn and drives 29 km. He takes a final right turn and drives 12 km and stops at point Q. What is the shortest distance between point Q and point B? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
